facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, yaşlılık sebebiyle aklın bozulmasıdır.
Bu bozulma özellikle yaşlı kişiye ilişen bir durum olarak anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: The branch phrase matches all supplied evidence: the sense is the impairment of reason because of old age, stated both as the condition itself and as what befalls an old person. No evidence in this branch makes false tales, roads, or autumn part of the meaning.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: This branch is age-related mental impairment, not mere lying, story-telling, road sense, or harvest season.

lexicalization_scope.note: Because lexicalization is unresolved, the definition follows only the attested condition of age-related mental impairment.
